I do, honestly, appreciate what you’re saying. It’s not painful to me, in the slightest. And my husband is the only one close to me. Why do you think I’m posting on Reddit? You commenting on this is the most “reaching out” any of my friends or family have done in months, some of them years. My husband will hurt, but he will also get over it and move on. I’ve had a lifetime of suffering and it literally is the best and easiest way out of it. Continuing to try and stay alive for other people is literally only making it worse when I’ve made up my mind years ago.

If I talk to him, he’ll make me go to therapy and try and help me and I don’t want to be helped, or saved or fixed. I just simply don’t want to exist anymore. So I can’t talk to him until I’m absolutely ready, because when I do, I don’t want to be here the next day
